items.note: S2.1 gives the signed exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restoration of arbitrary scratch values, but calls all three stages forward invocations (the paper's middle stage is the inverse schedule from Y to X) and gives no h, N, m, gadget maps or the net-change identity (JV+RG)x=x.

S2.2 states the common frame per gate, edge change D_vD_u^{-1}, commutation with pointwise gates and the implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, as at 806-817; the route form eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} is left implicit.

S2.3.1 states comparable nondegenerate labels, central 3->4 edges as the only decreasing ones losing h, and the total Wm-2N+2L with L<N/2; it omits L=Ich and the ratios 100/539, 101/539, and the method sketch has no residual table or neighbour orthogonality, so it is not a derivation.

S2.3.2 gives the endpoint difference I_m on every role and s_b<W_b m from ranks of projection differences, but omits the source matrices -P_{U_a}, the formula s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b and the rank-one source exceptions.

S2.4 has one translation kernel aI+bX_v per residual basis vector, s_c<W_cm and C^{tensor m} on every role, but omits the inverse kernels, the phase frames C_U, the count s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c and the source/sink diagonal corrections needed before telescoping gives C^{tensor m}.
The plan states s_b<W_bm, s_c<W_cm and s/W<m^tau, but never gives tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, the deficits eta, or the argument via eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and does not link L<N/2 to the deficit N-2L.
S1.1 and S1.2 list the O(V) primitives correctly, but S1.2 drops the conditions that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time and that q be prime with coefficients prime to q.

S3.1 and S3.2 state A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones and the cost of exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V), matching 1364-1410; the elimination proof and the one-swap pivot sequence (1436-1440) are not shown.

Follows the paper's route: role-stream split, Phi_M frames, rank-many interchanges on V/W, the three-update interchange, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), F_k=O(e^tau). 'Enough rows' loosens the W^k divisibility condition, and the fixed-tape depth-first schedule that makes the node overhead O(V) (1559-1588) is missing.

S3.4 and S3.5 give padding rows to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces and padding [2^u] to [q^e], matching 1684-1734. The essential step of making the row field from the chunks' own top rho digits (exchange and join of high parts, 1652-1683) is absent.

S4.1 (s_c child calls on f=e/m axes giving C^{tensor e}) and S4.2 (H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D) match 1904-1931; the P_M conjugation, the elimination into row additions and the inverse-child identity are not given.

S4.3 states the selected-bit XOR with a restored third chunk at cost O(V(L^tau+1)), which is only the parameter-family simplification; the bad set, delta_bad and the repair terms of eq:packed-rectangle-time are missing (S8.8 only alludes to the repair).
S4.4 names 'the recurrence' and the 1/W_c child volume and gives O(Vd^{lambda'}), but not F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1), the leaves at e<d^beta or the condition on lambda'.

The sub-steps follow the proof at 2686-2758 (phase reduction, 1/W_c volume, packed basis changes, conversion to H_0, guard width o(p), row sum one). The statement says 'each of d chunks' where the paper has D<=d chunks with K=floor(d^c); the recurrence analysis and the guard-width depth recurrence are only asserted.

Character cancellation, bit-reversed B_tF_t^-, the layout by prefix moves and at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges, simultaneous rounds, prefix-slot rounds and the error sqrt2*l*2^{-p} with the stated cost all match the paper's route.

S5.4 matches the lemma: exact product by signed Kronecker packing with the established multiplier, returning Q_p(fg/r) in O(rp log(rp)); the evaluation point 2^{4p} and centred residues are not given.
Retained-order pipeline (pointwise products commute with a common permutation), F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g), error sqrt2*M(3l+1)2^{-p} and cost all as in the paper.

The identities, approximation error and costs, tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2 and line-exposure cost are right, but P_s, P_t and the hypothesis theta>p/alpha^4 are not in the statement (alpha^4 theta_i>p appears only in S7.1.3). The construction of A and B_0 through S, T and the inverse of N is not shown.
Both identities, the coefficient check, RF^+R=F^+ with permutations commuting with pointwise products, and the 1/S^2 normalization follow 3938-3988; conjugation for RF^+ is in S7.4.4.

Sizes, prime intervals, T/2<S<T, the resampling hypotheses and no wraparound match the paper. The fixed exponents (other than kappa in S0), eta=1/(4d), alpha and gamma are not given, and prime existence is asserted without the Rosser-Schoenfeld argument.

Phi, its triangular coordinates as prefix-controlled shifts and the cost O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)) are correct, but mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i is not defined, and the reason Phi is an isomorphism (the image of x has order S) is not shown.
S7.3 gives the twist by zeta^k and the wrap check; S7.4.1 gives D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T; the computed version's twist errors are not treated.
Source transform composition with exact counterpart RF_s, conjugate procedure, and the six algorithm steps with the two scales by S match 4415-4544.

E_s, E_w, the final <1/2 bound, rounding, carries and the 2n-bit output follow the paper. The ring and chirp error stages (5TL, 8TL) are skipped, and the passage from 2^{-b+gamma} to 2^{-3b/4} via gamma<=b/4 is not stated.

Min margin 2^{-181}=2kappa, several normalized rows, setup, repair, log absorption, total and the schoolbook cutoff match. The margin formulas g_i (notably g_2=eps c(1-tau)) and the dK, l d^{lambda'}, log(rp) rows are not tabulated in S8.
S0 only lists n-log-n-conjecture among its dependencies; no step explains that one machine with liminf T(n)/(n lg n)=0 refutes an eventual lower bound.

errors.says: Three stages of forward invocations send (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a).
errors.paper: Stage 2 is the inverse forward schedule with logical source Y and target X, effecting X<-X-Y; only stages 1 and 3 are forward invocations from X to Y. Three forward X->Y invocations would give y+3x, not the exchange.

errors.says: Each edge's phase-frame change is a product of translation kernels aI+bX_v, and telescoping gives C^{tensor m} on every role.
errors.paper: The factors are aI+bX_v or its inverse, and C^{tensor m} on every role holds only after source and sink diagonal corrections (Z_{a,k}, i^{27k}) and undoing the signed exchange; uncorrected, the X_a->Y_a route has C^{-1} on 27 coordinates.

errors.says: H_0 applied to the same bit position in each of d address chunks.
errors.paper: The layer acts on D chunks with 1<=D<=d, each of K=floor(d^c) bits.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route: bit network, shear interface, triangular factorization, power-width recurrence, chunk swap, then complex network, phase frames, simultaneous layer, synthetic transforms, resampling with chirp cancellation, assembly, error and cost table. It thins out at the saving: the plan asserts L<N/2 and s<Wm without the rank-equals-dimension-change argument, L=Ich or the 100/539 ratio, never gives tau=1-2^{-50}, and leaves the butterfly-layer recurrence, the fixed-tape schedule and the high-digit row field unstated.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch wires is stated, but h=100, the triple indexing, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 never appear.
Common frame per gate commuting with pointwise gates, the implemented D_out S D_in^{-1}, and cost only on edge changes D_vD_u^{-1}.
Nondegenerate subspace labels from triple indicators in an m-dimensional space; comparable labels on every edge; only the central 3->4 edges decrease, each by h.
The plan adds 'ranks of the projection differences' but never states rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U or the N rank-one source exceptions.
Sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L is stated, but L=Ich and s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b are missing, so the passage from the dimension budget to the rank sum is absent.
L<N/2 and s<Wm are both asserted, but the ratio 100/539 (101/539) and the deficit N-2L>0 linking them are not given.
Endpoint difference I_m on every input role and the resulting shear H<-H+D on every role stream; the source matrix -P_{U_a} is not named.
E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V), and s calls on streams of volume V/W per node.
F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) and F_k=O(e^tau) from s/W<m^tau are present, but tau=1-2^{-50} and its derivation from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 are absent; marked mentioned to be conservative.

central.summary: The plan carries the mechanism of the saving (frames, nested labels with one decreasing family, the endpoint identity, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the s/W recurrence), but leaves the quantitative core as bare assertions: no h, N or m, no rank-equals-dimension-change, no L=Ich or 100/539, no deficit N-2L, and no tau=1-2^{-50}. Four of the nine steps are reconstructed.
